title: Declare the stage 2 walking requirements in one file
summary: configs/walking_requirements.json now owns everything the survey asks of the walking controller on flat ground: the two translation speeds at eight bearings, the turn rate, the arc, stand, the 2 s minimum hold, the 0.12 m stop tolerance, the tilt and torque limits and the GPS-only pose source. The payload is the Livox Mid-360 lidar, 0.265 kg sensor only; mount, cable and deck electronics are not yet decided. A navigation test binds the command bank and the follower defaults to the file, so neither side can change alone. The 0.10 and 0.20 m/s cases, the 0.4 rad/s turns and the stage 2C formal cases are not requirements; they stay in the evaluator as diagnostics.
next: Bind the locomotion evaluator to the file by building the acceptance cases from it, then record which requirement set the accepted controller meets.
reason: A requirements declaration and a CPU test are added. Runtime locomotion sources, checkpoints, the approved robot, acceptance gates and roadmap markers remain unchanged.
